Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the operations coordinator role at Harbor Tools. I enjoy the practical work of helping people stay connected to the information and schedules they need, and I would welcome the opportunity to bring that attention to your team. At Portside Supply, I coordinated a calendar for 18 people and kept an eye on how work moved between colleagues. I logged missed handoffs as they fell from 9 to 3 over 6 weeks, and I gathered feedback from colleagues to understand their experience of the process. That work reinforced for me how much careful coordination depends on listening as well as keeping records. A calendar can make commitments visible, while feedback can reveal where the day-to-day experience needs closer attention. I would be glad to bring that same combination of organization, curiosity, and respect for colleagues’ perspectives to Harbor Tools. Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the chance to discuss the role and learn more about how your team works.

Warmly,
Maya Reed
